newsitem.title: EGYPT: British Air plans London/Alexandria service-source.
newsitem.headline: British Air plans London/Alexandria service-source.

text.p: British Airways Plc will launch flights twice a week between London and the Egyptian Mediterranean city of Alexandria by the end of October, a company source said on Sunday.
The airline has yet to decide whether the outbound flights will be on Mondays and Thursdays or Tuesdays and Fridays, the source, who asked anonymity, told Reuters.
The aircraft type was not immediately known but the Airbus 320, with some 300 seats, is the most likely, the source said.
The Alexandria flights will match the twice-weekly Cairo-Manchester flights operated by EgyptAir.
